subject.title: fix(memory): search memory and wiki concurrently for corpus=all (#92633)

question: Should this PR keep closing the broader all-corpus timeout issue, or should the closing reference be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The code fix addresses the additive-latency root cause, but the linked issue also asks for timeout attribution/debug behavior that is tracked by a separate open PR.

options.title: Narrow Closing Reference
options.body: Change the PR body from a closing reference to a normal reference so the concurrency fix can land while the broader issue remains open for attribution/debug follow-up.

options.title: Accept Central Closure
options.body: Treat the concurrency fix as solving the central user problem and leave the attribution/debug behavior to a separate follow-up path.

options.title: Pause For Coordination
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose one coordinated merge path for concurrency and timeout-attribution behavior.

recommendation.title: Narrow Closing Reference
recommendation.body: Change the PR body from a closing reference to a normal reference so the concurrency fix can land while the broader issue remains open for attribution/debug follow-up.
